basic_details.job_title: JMI Interns Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI), New Delhi, has 11 vacant internship seats for the academic session 2026–2027. The seats are for external candidates who passed the final BDS Examination on or before 15 November 2026. Candidates must submit the prescribed application form and the required documents at the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi. Applications must be in by 16 November 2026, 04:00 PM. No application will be accepted after that time.

content_sections.heading: About JMI Faculty of Dentistry
content_sections.text: The Faculty of Dentistry is a faculty of Jamia Millia Islamia, a university in New Delhi (PIN 110025). This notice offers the one-year BDS internship there to students from other dental institutions. The internship is run under the Ordinances of Jamia Millia Islamia.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form attached to the notice and submit it with the required documents to this address: Office of the Dean, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025. The deadline is 16 November 2026, 04:00 PM. The notice says the Institute will not be responsible for any delay in postal delivery or in delivery through any other agency, so the application has to reach the office by that time. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope. The application form has these parts: Personal details: name of the student, father's name, date of birth, nationality, religion, marital status, whether you belong to OBC/SC/ST, address for correspondence, email ID and mobile number. Academic details: the name and full address of the institution where you are doing the BDS Programme, the name and address of the affiliated university, the date you joined the BDS Programme and the date you passed the final BDS Examination. Reason and documents: your reason for seeking internship at Jamia, and a list of the documents and certificates you have attached (you may add extra sheets). Detail of BDS Examination Passed: for each year (I, II, III and Final) and each paper (Paper No. I to VIII), give the subject name, the number of extra attempts, the percentage of marks in the subject and any distinction or medal in the subject. Then give the overall percentage. Photo and undertaking: paste a self-attested photograph on the form, then sign the undertaking and write your name in block letters. In the undertaking you declare that your statements are true. If facts are found to be hidden or misrepresented at any stage, your candidature for internship may be cancelled without any liability on Jamia Millia Islamia. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The JMI internship has 11 vacant seats for external candidates for the academic session 2026–2027. Eligibility and terms, as printed in the notice: Educational qualification: passed the final BDS Examination on or before 15.11.2026. Recognition of the parent institution: your parent institution must certify that it is recognised by the National Dental Commission (formerly DCI). It must also certify that it was not de-recognised by the National Dental Commission at any time from your admission until you passed out. University permission: you need permission from the university your college is affiliated to. Stipend: the prescribed stipend of ₹3000/- only per month. Training fee: ₹1,75,000/- (Rs. One Lakh and seventy five thousand only), paid only if you are selected. Pay it by Demand Draft in favour of "Registrar, JMI", payable at New Delhi, before the internship starts. The fee will be non-refundable after the training period starts. Duration: one year, as per the NDC guideline. Part internship is not permissible, and selected candidates undertake not to ask for an extension of the internship period. Rules: the internship is governed by the provisions of the Ordinances of Jamia Millia Islamia. For the full eligibility conditions, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attach these documents to the application. They come from the notice and its checklist of documents: An application giving your reasons for wanting to do the internship at the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI, with documentary proof. Self-attested photocopies of the marksheets of all BDS Annual Examinations (each part/year). An attempt certificate issued by the University/College, showing the number of attempts and the percentage of marks in each part/year. A No Objection Certificate from your parent institution, covering its recognition as described above. Permission from the university your college is affiliated to, allowing you to do the internship at the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI, subject to selection. A certificate of good character and conduct from your parent institution. Documentary evidence of any distinction or medal awarded in any subject in a University Examination. An undertaking with three parts: (a) you are prepared to do the internship on the stipend of ₹3000/- per month and will deposit ₹1,75,000/- as the fee if selected; (b) you will follow the rules and regulations of the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI's internship program and will not ask for an extension; (c) you will maintain good conduct, discipline and decorum, and you accept that the University authorities have the right to expel you for misconduct, indiscipline or unsatisfactory work without any liability on the University. Two photographs: one self-attested, pasted on the application form, and one without attestation. The checklist page has a "Mark √ or X" column for each document.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made on the basis of merit and an interview. The stages, in order: Verification of documents: 18 November 2026. Interview: 23 November 2026, from 11:00 AM onwards, in the Conference Room, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia. Result: the tentative date is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many internship seats does the JMI Faculty of Dentistry offer in 2026?
faq.answer: The Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, has 11 vacant internship seats for external candidates for the academic session 2026–2027.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JMI internship?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 November 2026, up to 04:00 PM. The Institute is not responsible for postal or other delivery delays, so the application must reach the Office of the Dean by then.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the JMI BDS internship?
faq.answer: External candidates who passed the final BDS Examination on or before 15 November 2026 can apply. They need an NOC confirming that their parent institution is recognised by the National Dental Commission (formerly DCI), and permission from their affiliated university.

faq.question: Q4. What stipend does a JMI intern get?
faq.answer: Interns get the prescribed stipend of ₹3000/- only per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the training fee for the JMI internship?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must pay ₹1,75,000/- by Demand Draft in favour of "Registrar, JMI", payable at New Delhi, before the internship starts. The fee is non-refundable after the training period starts.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the JMI Faculty of Dentistry internship?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form attached to the notice and attach the required documents and two photographs. Then submit it to the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025, by 04:00 PM on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the JMI internship?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit and an interview. Documents are verified on 18 November 2026, and the interview is on 23 November 2026 from 11:00 AM onwards in the Conference Room, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia.

faq.question: Q8. When will the JMI internship result be declared and when does the internship begin?
faq.answer: The tentative result date is 27 November 2026. The internship begins on 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the JMI internship, and can it be done in part?
faq.answer: The internship lasts one year, as per the NDC guideline. Part internship is not permissible, and candidates undertake not to ask for an extension of the internship period.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if an application is missing a document?
faq.answer: An application without the documents required by the notice will be summarily rejected. No extension will be given for submitting any document.
